name: Big Muff Pi
description: Iconic fuzz pedal known for its thick, sustaining tone. Used by Jimi Hendrix, David Gilmour, and Jack White. Delivers a creamy wall of fuzz that works great for leads and power chords.

name: Tube Screamer TS-9
description: The classic mid-boost overdrive that defined blues-rock tone. Famous for pushing tube amps into sweet breakup. Popularized by Stevie Ray Vaughan.

name: Boss DS-1
description: One of the best-selling distortion pedals of all time. Provides a hard-clipping distortion ranging from mild crunch to heavy saturation. Used by Kurt Cobain and Joe Satriani.

name: Klon Centaur
description: Legendary transparent overdrive pedal. Adds gain without coloring your base tone. Original units sell for thousands on the used market. Often called the holy grail of overdrives.

name: ProCo RAT
description: Versatile distortion pedal capable of everything from light overdrive to heavy fuzz-like saturation. The Filter knob rolls off highs for a thicker sound. A staple on pedalboards since the 80s.

name: MXR Phase 90
description: Simple one-knob phaser that produces a warm, swirling modulation. Heard on countless Van Halen recordings. The script logo version is sought after for its smoother, more subtle sweep.

name: Boss DD-3
description: Digital delay offering up to 800ms of delay time. Clean repeats that sit well in a mix. Three time range modes for short slapback to longer ambient echoes.
controls: Effect Level, Feedback, Delay Time, Mode

name: Electro-Harmonix Holy Grail
description: Lush digital reverb in a compact enclosure. Three modes: Spring (classic amp-style), Hall (spacious room), and Flerb (flanged reverb for experimental textures).

name: Dunlop Cry Baby GCB95
description: The original wah pedal design. A rocker pedal that sweeps a resonant bandpass filter for that classic funk and rock wah sound. Used by Jimi Hendrix, Slash, and Kirk Hammett.

name: Strymon Timeline
description: Premium multi-algorithm digital delay with 12 delay types including tape, analog, ice, and reverse. 200 preset slots, tap tempo, MIDI control, and studio-quality sound.
controls: Time, Repeats, Mix, Filter, Grit, Speed, Depth, Type

name: Boss CE-2W
description: Waza Craft reissue of the legendary CE-2 chorus. Produces a warm, shimmering modulation. Two modes: Standard (CE-2 circuit) and CE-1 (chorus ensemble). Essential for clean tones.

name: EHX Small Clone
description: Simple chorus pedal made famous by Kurt Cobain on Nevermind. A depth switch toggles between subtle shimmer and deep warble. One of the most recognizable chorus sounds in rock.

name: TC Electronic Hall of Fame 2
description: Versatile reverb with TonePrint technology for loading custom artist presets via smartphone. Shimmer mode adds an octave-up reverb for ambient soundscapes. MASH footswitch for expression control.

name: JHS Morning Glory
description: Transparent low-to-medium gain overdrive inspired by the Marshall Bluesbreaker circuit. Cleans up beautifully with your guitar's volume knob. Great for always-on foundation tone.

name: Walrus Audio Julia
description: Analog chorus and vibrato with a unique dry/wet blend knob (D-C-V). Ranges from subtle chorus to seasick vibrato. Lag control adds a flanging quality at extreme settings.

name: EarthQuaker Devices Afterneath
description: An otherworldly reverb that generates a swarm of short delays to create a cavernous, ambient wash. Drag control adjusts delay time for everything from tight reflections to infinite caverns.
controls: Length, Diffuse, Dampen, Drag, Mix, Reflect

name: MXR Carbon Copy
description: Warm analog delay with up to 600ms of delay time using bucket-brigade chips. Modulation switch adds a subtle chorus to the repeats for extra depth. Dark, musical repeats that never get harsh.

name: Boss TU-3
description: Industry-standard chromatic tuner pedal. Bright LED display visible in any lighting. Supports 7-string guitars and 6-string basses. Provides a buffered output to maintain signal quality in long chains.

name: Fulltone OCD
description: Versatile drive pedal that covers everything from clean boost to thick distortion. The HP/LP toggle changes the clipping character. Responds dynamically to picking intensity and guitar volume.

name: Chase Bliss Audio Mood
description: Experimental micro-looper and reverb/delay hybrid. Two channels (wet and clock) create unpredictable ambient textures. DIP switches on the back unlock hidden parameters. Beloved by ambient guitarists.
controls: Time, Length, Mix, Clock, Modify, Channel Toggle

name: Wampler Tumnus
description: A faithful Klon Centaur clone in a mini enclosure. Transparent overdrive that preserves your amp's character while adding smooth gain and presence. Fraction of the price of an original Klon.

name: EHX POG2
description: Polyphonic octave generator that tracks chords flawlessly. Produces sub-octave, dry, and octave-up signals simultaneously. Built-in attack slider and LP filter for organ-like tones.
controls: Sub Octave, Dry, Octave Up, Attack, LP Filter, Detune, Preset

name: Boss RC-5
description: Compact loop station with up to 13 hours of recording time. 99 phrase memories, built-in rhythm patterns, and USB for importing/exporting loops. Undo/redo for layering.

name: Digitech Whammy
description: Expression pedal-controlled pitch shifter offering harmonized intervals, detune, and the famous dive-bomb effect. A signature tool for Tom Morello and Jack White. Classic setting: 2 octaves up.

name: Way Huge Swollen Pickle
description: Scooped mid fuzz with extreme range of tones. Internal trim pots allow fine-tuning of voice and clip characteristics. From smooth singing fuzz to gnarly gated sputtering chaos.
controls: Loudness, Sustain, Filter, Scoop, Internal Trims
